verdict.rationale: Gusto's own Business Compliance product documents annual and initial report filing with the Secretary of State across all 50 states. Proactive deadline alerts that cover annual reports support on-time filing, and an independent CPA Practice Advisor report corroborates annual report filing. Franchise tax filing is never mentioned; the only tax-related item is "annual tax reminders," which notifies rather than files. missing for 10: documented franchise tax filing, hands-on evidence of on-time filing in practice.
